notes: Carbon sorbents: the KOH-activated porous carbons SBL-CO-PP-C-7 and SBL-CO-PP-C-20. EDS (main p. 8, journal p. 32804) gives C 52.01, N 36.22, O 7.80 at.% for C-7 (carbon about 50% by mass, the largest component) and C 56.10, N 43.90 at.% for C-20 (carbon about 52% by mass), so carbon is the majority component of at least C-20 and the largest of both. CO-PP-0 and the SBL-CO-PP-7/-20 composites are uncarbonized cross-linked polymer with 7-20 wt% activated carbon, so they are not counted as carbon sorbents. Measurements by Sieverts (PCTPro-E&E with microdoser), 77 K and 298 K, 0-20 bar; Table 2 and Fig. 6 call the 77 K values excess. Fig. S2 adds one earlier-published point (SBL-PNP-0.25-4-750, 'From JMCA, 6, 23087-23100, 2018'), but the paper does not say all its values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. The text layer renders the dashes in sample names as 'e' (SBLeCOePP-C-7); quotes use the dashes printed on the page images. Not retracted (record flag false; no retraction notice in the PDF).
